description:
MyGGV GPS guides you to any address inside Garden Grove Village.

Choose a block, then a lot: the app draws the route on the village map and guides you step by step until you arrive.

• Every block and lot of the village
• Step-by-step directions in English, with a short Tagalog line
• The village map is stored in the app and works without a connection
• An arrival chime and vibration when you reach the lot
• No account, no ads

Route calculation needs an internet connection. Without one, the app points straight at your destination.

Made for residents and visitors of Garden Grove Village.
promotionalText: Find any block and lot in Garden Grove Village, with step-by-step directions in English and Tagalog. The village map works offline.
